import subprocess, sys, time, json
def t(name, payload):
    t0 = time.time()
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "/workspace/submission/main.py"], input=payload, capture_output=True)
    el = time.time()-t0
    out = p.stdout.decode().splitlines()
    print("%-34s %6.2fs rc=%d lines=%d first=%s" % (name, el, p.returncode, len(out), out[0][:70] if out else ""))
# complete objects with huge service tokens
p1 = b'{"services":["' + b"a" * 1048500 + b'"],"rules":[],"queries":[]}'
t("1MB service token (complete)", p1 + b"\n")
t("1MB service exactly 1048576", p1 + b" " * (1048576 - len(p1)) + b"\n")
t("1MB service 1048577", p1 + b" " * (1048577 - len(p1)) + b"\n")
p2 = b'{"services":["' + b'\\"' * 524200 + b'"],"rules":[],"queries":[]}'
t("1MB escaped quotes (complete)", p2 + b"\n")
# 50k keys (fits in 1MB)
t("50k keys", b"{" + b",".join(b'"k%d":%d' % (i, i) for i in range(50000)) + b"}\n")
t("100k ints array", b"[" + b",".join(str(i).encode() for i in range(100000)) + b"]\n")
# deep nesting inside a string that is inside a valid doc
p3 = b'{"services":["' + b"[" * 64 + b'"],"rules":[],"queries":[["' + b"[" * 64 + b'"]]}'
t("brackets inside strings", p3 + b"\n")
# atom path with 16 tokens over 24 services
svc = ["s%02d" % i for i in range(24)]
req = {"services": svc, "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "contains", "path": svc[:16]}},
                                  {"action": "drop", "when": {"op": "endswith", "path": svc[8:16]}},
                                  {"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "startswith", "path": svc[:3]}}],
       "queries": [svc, svc[:5], svc[:20]]}
t("16-token atoms", (json.dumps(req) + "\n").encode())
print(json.dumps(json.loads(subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "/workspace/submission/main.py"], input=(json.dumps(req)+"\n").encode(), capture_output=True).stdout)["dfa"])[:400])
EOF
